name: High Lord Modolfr

facts.text: High Lord Modolfr is a level-44 werewolf lord (faction Varulv) in his wing of Varulvhamn (26,047/32,746) among werewolf advisors, frukta wargs, wolfaur lunarians, a scavenger and an elite guard; aggressive.
facts.source: runtime/data/opendaoc.sqlite3.db, Mob and NpcTemplate tables (0.37b world data)

facts.text: Modolfr as the high lord who wants war later is Living Server lore.
Old Norse modr is 'courage, wrath' and ulfr 'wolf'; the name would read 'wrath-wolf' or 'brave wolf'.

story:
Modolfr wants war too, later. He is the patient one of the three high lords, the wrath-wolf of the old name who keeps his wrath in a box, and he holds the wing where the wolfaur lunarians walk, the old moon-watchers who count the nights to every change. Modolfr counts with them. The court says he has a night picked, a night when the moon and the season and the realm's troubles will all be right, and that he will not say which, because a war announced is a war half lost.

Hallkel Thorvaldsson of Skona, who wrote down what he could of the court's arguments, says Modolfr and Athulf have the same quarrel every season and both enjoy it. The king lets them. The young Midgard sends for the lords' essences find Modolfr waiting in his wing among his advisors and moon-watchers as if he had picked that night too, and perhaps he had.
legend: High Lord Modolfr is a level 44 Varulv high lord in his wing of Varulvhamn among advisors, frukta wargs and wolfaur lunarians. One of the three Werewolf Bane essences. Varulv faction, so his wing fights with him. A full mid-40s group handles it. His wing is west of Athulf's, past the lower halls. Watch the lunarians at the edge of his wing.

aggro: Tonight? No. But you will do.
The moon was not right for you.

lairEntry: Moon-watchers count the nights. A high lord waits.
